benchmarks.name: Single VC Issuance Latency
benchmarks.summary: Executed 100 consecutive cryptographic VC signatures via secp256k1. Mean: 1.85ms (Throughput: 540.54 VCs/sec).

benchmarks.name: 1-Click Mass Bulk Issuance Throughput
benchmarks.summary: Executed 10 mass batches generating 300 total credentials. Mean Batch Time: 2423.52ms (12.38 VCs/sec).

benchmarks.name: Verifier Presentation Verification Latency
benchmarks.summary: Executed 100 in-memory presentation verifications with signature validation and anti-theft check. Mean: 0.19ms (5263.16 verifications/sec).

benchmarks.name: DIDComm Mediator WebSocket Transit Delay
benchmarks.summary: Executed 100 asynchronous DIDComm message relays via Mediator HTTP/WebSocket queue. Mean Transit Delay: 3.86ms (259.07 msg/sec).

benchmarks.name: Smart Contract Gas Footprint on Geth PoA
benchmarks.summary: Measured EVM execution gas cost across 25 transactions on Geth Private PoA: issueVCTenant() = 58660 gas units, revokeVC() = 32266 gas units.
